title: 2025年12月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
paperTitle: 2025年12月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
prompt: Suppose it is proposed that all university students should be required to learn academic writing. You are now to write a response by stating what you think of the proposal. You will have 30 minutes to write the essay. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
reference: It has recently been proposed that all university students should be required to learn academic writing. In my view, this proposal deserves our full support, for such a skill is far more than an optional refinement. For one thing, academic writing trains students to organize ideas logically and cite sources honestly. When I wrote my first term paper, I struggled to structure arguments and nearly copied online material by mistake; a writing course would have taught me both clear reasoning and academic integrity. For another, this ability pays off well beyond campus. Whether a graduate applies for a research position or drafts a report at work, the capacity to express thoughts precisely on paper often determines success. Admittedly, mastering academic writing takes time and effort. Nevertheless, the long-term rewards clearly outweigh the cost. Therefore, I strongly believe universities should make this course compulsory, ideally starting from the first year so that students benefit throughout their studies.
keyPoints: 复述加表态。首段落实『复述加表态开篇』：It has recently been proposed that... 用同义 改写复述提案、点题；紧接 In my view, this proposal deserves our full support 一句亮明支持立场， 兑现 stating what you think of the proposal，开篇即拿任务分。
分点加例证。第二段落实『分点理由配例证』：For one thing... for another... 两条理由并 列；中间 When I wrote my first term paper... 用亲身场景把『论文规范与学术诚信』坐实，Whether a graduate... 把价值延伸到就业深造，两条都咬住学术写作本身，不空谈。
让步加重申。第三段落实『让步转折收尾』：Admittedly... 先认成本，Nevertheless... 转折 抬高回报，Therefore, I strongly believe... 顺势重申应必修并补『从大一开设』的温和建议，立场首尾 一致、毫不摇摆。
